subtitleConverter: Write, convert, listen. At your own pace.
fileLimit: UTF-8 .txt files · Up to 8 MiB each · Existing files are never replaced.
updateUnavailable: Update check unavailable. You can continue offline.
nativeUnavailable: The conversion engine could not be loaded. Reinstall the app package.
practiceNote: Practice uses the international Latin alphabet. 10 questions per session.
normalizationNote: Latin: Turkish letters are simplified. Russian: Ё → Е. Arabic: marks and tatweel are omitted; hamza carriers, ى and ة are normalized. Decoding cannot restore the original spelling.
question: Question
settingsRecovered: Preferences could not be read; defaults are in use.
unsupported: A character is not supported by the selected alphabet.
invalidMorse: Check the Morse code and word separator.
speechUnavailable: Speech is not available on this platform yet.
fileError: File conversion failed. Check UTF-8 encoding, the 8 MiB limit and an unused output name.
speechLimit: Speech is limited to 4000 characters at a time.
converterHint: Enter text or Morse code. Convert, copy and listen in one place.
speechLocalNote: Text is processed on this device. Stop also cancels speech.
arabicVoiceNote: Kareem: Jordanian Arabic, one speaker. Text stays on this device.
speechPackMissing: Offline speech pack missing. Select it in Settings → Speech pack.
speechPackHelp: Install the pack once; speech works without internet. Models load only during synthesis. If you moved the pack, select its folder.
speechError: Speech generation failed. Check the speech pack installation.
thanksBody: Thank you to the developers of the open-source models and tools that make offline speech possible.
creditsLicenseNote: Engines and voice models have separate licenses; each source retains its own license.
